Acute Care

Your partner in prevention

With a commitment to innovation, we're transforming care experiences for patients and clinicians alike across the continuum of care. From hospital-acquired conditions like inpatient falls and pressure injuries to enhanced clinical workflows—together, we're shaping a future where every patient receives a high standard of care, and every caregiver feels empowered to deliver it.

Tomorrow’s tech for today’s confident care

Prime Connect is the first smart, connected hospital stretcher on the market designed to help support fall prevention protocols from anywhere in your facility.

Smart, connected hospital bed system

Our safest and most intelligent bed yet, ProCuity is a versatile bed for all patient care environments.

text_copy.text:
Proud sponsor of the ANA Innovation Awards 

Building a strong nurse workforce, in numbers and skillset, is vital to advancing healthcare in the future. Our Acute Care business is proud to partner with the American Nurses Association, an organization that represents 4.2 million nurses, to sponsor the ANA Innovation Awards. The awards celebrate nurse-led innovations that improve patient safety and health outcomes.
